svākāra: Svākāra [su+ākāra] 좋은 기질을 갖고 있는 Vin I.6.
svākkhāta: Svākkhāta [su+akkhāta; on the long ā cp. Geiger, P.Gr. § 7; BSk. svākhyāta] 잘 가르친 Vin I.12, 187; II.199; M I.67; A I.34; II.56; Sn 567. Opp. durakkhāta Vism 213 (in detail).
svāgata: Svāgata [su+āgata] 1. 환영 Vin II.11; Th 2, 337; ThA 236. -- 2. ~을 외다 Vin II.95, 249; A IV.140 (pātimokkhāni). See sāgata.
svātana: Svātana [cp. Sk. śvastana; Geiger, P.Gr. § 6, 54] 다음 날에 관련된; dat. °--nāya 다음 날 동안에 Vin I.27; D I.125; J I.11; DhA I.314; IV.12.
sve: Sve (adv.) [cp. Sk. śvas] 내일 Vin II.77; D I.108, 205; J I.32, 243; II.47; VvA 230; svedivasa DhA I.103. 방언 형태는 suve, e. g. Pv IV.15; Mhvs 29, 17; 이중으로 쓰이면 suve suve 매일같이 Dh 229; DhA III.329; J V.507.
